source.title: Pathology and mineralogy of the pneumoconioses.

whyItFits: Open review section on hard-metal pneumoconiosis: cobalt-containing alloy exposure, hypersensitivity, ground-glass imaging, and giant-cell interstitial pneumonia.
limitations: The hard-metal section of an open pneumoconiosis review (PMC author manuscript). A single atypical letter without giant-cell interstitial pneumonia was rejected.
